                    ### Question
                    Which of the following is currently the only contraindication for conservative surgical treatment in breast cancer?

                    ### Options
                    opa. Prior radiotherapy.
opb. Tumor of 4 cm.
opc. Axillary metastasis.
opd. Multifocal tumor
ope. Pregnancy of 32 weeks.

### Enhanced Information (For Contextual Support):
The only contraindication for conservative surgical treatment in breast cancer is a pregnancy of 32 weeks, as it limits surgical options due to pregnancy-related considerations. Prior radiotherapy may increase the risk of complications during surgery but is not the only contraindication. Tumor size of 4 cm is considered amenable to conservative surgical treatment and is not a contraindication. Axillary metastasis may indicate advanced disease stage but does not directly contraindicate conservative surgical treatment. Multifocal tumor complexity may necessitate more extensive surgical intervention but is not the only contraindication.
